manifest.subject: english
manifest.title: 核心英语：情景交际、语法填空与语篇理解

knowledgeGraph.title: 情景交际与日常高频词块
校园科技与高频词组搭配
非谓语动词与长难句分析
短篇阅读主旨与词义推断

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 礼貌请求：Could you…? 常用于请对方做事；答应可说 Certainly；拒绝宜给出理由。
items.stemMd: — Could you pass me the salt? — ____
items.explanationMd: Certainly 表示同意递盐。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 礼貌请求：Could you…? 常用于请对方做事；答应可说 Certainly；拒绝宜给出理由。
items.stemMd: — Could you help me carry this box? — ____ I have a free hand.
items.explanationMd: 后句说有空手，因此 Of course 表示愿意帮忙。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: — Could you check my report now? — ____ I am about to leave, but I can read it tomorrow.
items.explanationMd: 马上要离开，故现在不能看，明天可看。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 感谢与道歉：Thanks 的回应是 You are welcome；道歉可用 That is all right，不要混淆。
items.stemMd: — Thanks for your help. — ____
items.explanationMd: You are welcome 回应感谢。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 感谢与道歉：Thanks 的回应是 You are welcome；道歉可用 That is all right，不要混淆。
items.stemMd: — Sorry I stepped on your foot. — ____ It was an accident.
items.explanationMd: 对方道歉，后句表明原谅，用 That is all right。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: — Thank you for waiting while I found the key. — ____

options.text: The key is made of metal.
Please do not thank me tomorrow.

items.explanationMd: No problem 可自然回应对方的感谢。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 预约与改期：book a seat 预订座位；put off 推迟；确认可行时间应结合上下文。
items.stemMd: — I would like to attend the lecture. How can I reserve a place? — You can ____ a seat online.（填一个动词，意为“预订”。）
items.explanationMd: book a seat 表示预订座位。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 预约与改期：book a seat 预订座位；put off 推迟；确认可行时间应结合上下文。
items.stemMd: — Is Monday at ten convenient? — No, I have class. ____

options.text: Could we meet on Tuesday instead?

items.explanationMd: 周一有课，因此提出改约周二。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: — Could we hold the meeting today? — The speaker is ill, so we must put it ____ until Friday.（填一个词）
items.explanationMd: put off 表示推迟。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 日常词块：pick up 接人或取物；run out of 用完；根据上下文判断动作对象。
items.stemMd: — Can you collect me from the station by car? — Yes, I will ____ you up at six.（填一个词）
items.explanationMd: pick someone up 表示开车接人。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 日常词块：pick up 接人或取物；run out of 用完；根据上下文判断动作对象。
items.stemMd: — May I have some milk? — Sorry, we have run out ____ milk.（填一个词）
items.explanationMd: run out of 表示用完。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: — The printer has run out of paper. Could you help? — Certainly. I will ____.
items.explanationMd: 打印机缺纸，首先应加纸。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 一般过去时：明确过去时间 last year 指向过去时；规则动词通常加 -ed。
items.stemMd: Yesterday she ____ (visit) her aunt.
items.explanationMd: Yesterday 表示过去，visit 的过去式是 visited。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 一般过去时：明确过去时间 last year 指向过去时；规则动词通常加 -ed。
items.stemMd: Last night we ____ (watch) a film.
items.explanationMd: Last night 标记过去，watch 变为 watched。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: The train ____ (leave) at eight yesterday morning.
items.explanationMd: yesterday morning 指过去，leave 的过去式是 left。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 现在完成时：since 引出过去起点，延续至今可用 have/has + 过去分词。
items.stemMd: She ____ (know) him since 2020.
items.explanationMd: know 表状态，since 2020 延续至今，用 has known。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 现在完成时：since 引出过去起点，延续至今可用 have/has + 过去分词。
items.stemMd: I ____ (be) a member of the club since 2022.
items.explanationMd: 从 2022 年至今是会员，用 have been。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: They ____ (own) this house since 2019 and still own it.
items.explanationMd: own 表拥有的状态，自 2019 年持续至今，用 have owned。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 被动语态：承受动作的主语使用 be + 过去分词；be 随时间和主语变化。
items.stemMd: The room ____ (clean) yesterday.
items.explanationMd: 房间被打扫，yesterday 对应 was cleaned。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 被动语态：承受动作的主语使用 be + 过去分词；be 随时间和主语变化。
items.stemMd: These letters ____ (send) last Monday.
items.explanationMd: 复数 letters 承受动作，过去时用 were sent。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: The bridge ____ (complete) in 2020.
items.explanationMd: bridge 承受建造完成动作，过去时被动用 was completed。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 核心从句：because 引导原因；定语从句中 who 指人并作主语；if 可引导条件。
items.stemMd: I stayed home ____ it was raining.（填一个词，表示“因为”。）
items.explanationMd: 下雨是待在家里的原因，用 because。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 核心从句：because 引导原因；定语从句中 who 指人并作主语；if 可引导条件。
items.stemMd: The technician ____ fixed the sensor is my mentor.（填关系代词）
items.explanationMd: 先行词指人且关系词作主语，可用 who 或 that。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: ____ it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside.（填一个词）
items.explanationMd: 前句是后句的条件，用 If 引导条件状语从句。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 语境中的因果：because 表原因；先判断空格前后的逻辑关系。
items.stemMd: Mia was leaving home for a walk. The weather forecast was uncertain. Mia took an umbrella because the sky was dark. She expected ____.
items.explanationMd: 天色昏暗且带伞，最可能预期下雨。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 语境中的因果：because 表原因；先判断空格前后的逻辑关系。
items.stemMd: Ben was on his way to work. It had snowed overnight. The path was icy, so Ben walked slowly to avoid ____.
items.explanationMd: 路面结冰，走慢是为了避免摔倒。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: Nora was preparing a report. She did not want to lose her work. Nora saved the document twice because the computer had crashed earlier. Her action shows ____.
items.explanationMd: 此前电脑崩溃，所以反复保存体现谨慎。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 语境中的转折：but/however 引出与前文预期相反的信息。
items.stemMd: Lee bought a bag for school. She was worried about carrying her books. The bag is small, but it is surprisingly ____. It holds all my books.
items.explanationMd: 能装下所有书，说明虽然小但空间大。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 语境中的转折：but/however 引出与前文预期相反的信息。
items.stemMd: We visited a café at lunchtime. Several customers were already waiting. The café was busy; however, the staff served us ____.
items.explanationMd: 虽然繁忙，但 however 引出服务迅速。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: A team was building a model. They wanted it to work reliably. The first plan failed. Nevertheless, the team tried a different design and succeeded. The team was ____.
items.explanationMd: 失败后换方案继续尝试，体现坚持不懈。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 指代与细节：代词通常回指语义最一致的前项，结合动作主体判断。
items.stemMd: Lina was getting ready to leave home. She looked for something she needed. Lina found her key under the chair. She put it in her pocket. What does it refer to?
items.explanationMd: 能放进口袋的是刚找到的钥匙。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 指代与细节：代词通常回指语义最一致的前项，结合动作主体判断。
items.stemMd: The library is collecting borrowed books this week. Students can return them at the front desk. A notice says: Return books by Friday. When is the deadline?
items.explanationMd: by Friday 表示最迟周五归还。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: The team was repairing a device. They needed to find the faulty part. The team tested a sensor and a battery. The sensor detected light, but the battery could not power the device. They replaced it. What did they replace?
items.explanationMd: 电池无法供电，因而他们更换的是电池。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 推理应有证据：区分文本事实与过度推断，只选由线索支持的结论。
items.stemMd: Sam is shopping for a notebook. He wants to pay before closing time. The shop closes at six. It is five fifty. How many minutes remain?（用数字填写）

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 推理应有证据：区分文本事实与过度推断，只选由线索支持的结论。
items.stemMd: Ada needed to get to work. She arrived at the bus stop on time. The bus was full, so Ada waited for the next one. Why did she wait?

options.text: There was no room on the bus.

items.explanationMd: full 表示车满了，没有空间。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: A gardener checked the plants this morning. The weather has been unusually dry. A garden received no rain for two weeks. The soil is dry, and the leaves are drooping. Which action is most directly supported?

options.text: Assume the plants need less sunlight.

items.explanationMd: 干土和垂叶支持先浇水；其他选项缺少依据。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 校园词汇：submit an assignment 提交作业；deadline 截止时间。
items.stemMd: Please ____ your assignment online before Friday.（填一个动词，意为“提交”。）
items.explanationMd: submit an assignment 表示提交作业。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 应用表达常用搭配：注意介词、不定式与动名词的固定用法。
items.stemMd: We look forward to ____ you at the workshop.
items.explanationMd: look forward to 后接动名词。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: Who is responsible ____ sending the invitation?
items.explanationMd: be responsible for 表示负责。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 根据句意和固定搭配，判断所需词形或介词。
items.stemMd: I look forward to ____ (hear) from you soon.
items.explanationMd: look forward to 后接动名词。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 应用表达常用搭配：注意介词、不定式与动名词的固定用法。
items.stemMd: We invite you to ____ part in the community event.
items.explanationMd: take part in 表示参加。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: Please arrive early in order ____ prepare the room.
items.explanationMd: in order to do 表示为了做某事。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 根据句意和固定搭配，判断所需词形或介词。
items.stemMd: We are responsible ____ preparing the materials.（填一个介词）
items.explanationMd: be responsible for 表示负责。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 应用表达常用搭配：注意介词、不定式与动名词的固定用法。
items.stemMd: Thank you ____ your kind assistance.
items.explanationMd: thank you for 后接感谢的事。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: Please let me know if you need any ____.
items.explanationMd: any 后可接不可数名词 help。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 根据句意和固定搭配，判断所需词形或介词。
items.stemMd: Please take part ____ the meeting on Monday.（填一个介词）
items.explanationMd: take part in 表示参加。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 应用表达常用搭配：注意介词、不定式与动名词的固定用法。
items.stemMd: We would like to ____ you to our exhibition.
items.explanationMd: invite somebody to 表示邀请某人参加。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: I would appreciate it if you could ____ me a reply by Friday.
items.explanationMd: send a reply 意为发送回复。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 不定式表目的：to + 动词原形可表示做某事的目的。
items.stemMd: She opened the window ____ let in fresh air.（填一个词，构成表示目的的不定式。）
items.explanationMd: to let in fresh air 表示开窗的目的。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 不定式表目的：to + 动词原形可表示做某事的目的。
items.stemMd: He went to the library ____ (borrow) a book.
items.explanationMd: to borrow a book 表示去图书馆的目的。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: To reduce waste, the class decided ____ (reuse) paper for notes.
items.explanationMd: decide to do 表示决定做某事。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 动名词作主语或宾语：enjoy 后接动名词；动名词作主语时谓语通常用单数。
items.stemMd: She enjoys ____ (read) after dinner.
items.explanationMd: enjoy 后接动名词 reading。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 动名词作主语或宾语：enjoy 后接动名词；动名词作主语时谓语通常用单数。
items.stemMd: ____ (swim) is good exercise.
items.explanationMd: 动名词 Swimming 作主语。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: They finished ____ (paint) the wall before lunch.
items.explanationMd: finish 后接动名词 painting。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 分词作状语：先找逻辑主语；主动关系常用现在分词，被动关系常用过去分词。
items.stemMd: ____ (see) from above, the lake looks blue.
items.explanationMd: 湖被看见，用过去分词 Seen。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 分词作状语：先找逻辑主语；主动关系常用现在分词，被动关系常用过去分词。
items.stemMd: ____ (walk) home, Mei met her teacher.
items.explanationMd: Mei 主动走路，用现在分词 Walking。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: ____ (build) in 1900, the house still stands.
items.explanationMd: 房子被建造，用过去分词 Built。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 根据句意和固定搭配，判断所需词形或介词。
items.stemMd: The report ____ (write) by the team yesterday is on the desk.
items.explanationMd: 过去分词 written 作后置定语，表示报告被写。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 长句拆解：先找主句主谓，再识别从句和修饰语；不要把从句动词当作主句谓语。
items.stemMd: The student thanked the teacher for ____ (help) her prepare for the competition.
items.explanationMd: 介词 for 后接动名词 helping。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: The report that the team published after testing the device explains its limits. What does the report explain?
items.explanationMd: 主句 report explains its limits；its 指所测试设备。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 主旨题：概括覆盖全文的共同信息，不用孤立细节替代主题。
items.stemMd: The class started a small garden in spring. They wanted to see how plants grow. A class planted seeds and watered them each day. Weeks later, green shoots appeared. What is the main idea?

options.text: A class grew plants from seeds.

items.explanationMd: 种子、浇水和发芽共同说明班级种植植物。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 主旨题：概括覆盖全文的共同信息，不用孤立细节替代主题。
items.stemMd: The town wanted to encourage cleaner travel. Officials made changes to its roads. The town added bike lanes. More residents began cycling to work. What is the passage mainly about?
items.explanationMd: 新增车道及更多人骑车，共同指向促进骑行的变化。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: The school wanted to save water. It started a practical project. A school saved rainwater for its garden. Students measured how much they used and adjusted their watering. What best summarizes the passage?

options.text: Rain never fell at the school.
Students managed water for a school garden.
Every garden uses the same amount.

items.explanationMd: 收集、测量和调整用水共同体现管理花园用水。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 词义推断：用定义、同义改写或上下文动作推断，不脱离原句。
items.stemMd: A group was walking through the hills. They followed a trail into the woods. The path was narrow: only one person could walk along it at a time. Copy the word that means “not wide”.
items.explanationMd: 一次只能一人通过；原文 narrow 表示不宽。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 词义推断：用定义、同义改写或上下文动作推断，不脱离原句。
items.stemMd: Kai was packing items for a move. One item needed special care. The glass was fragile, so Kai wrapped it carefully to prevent it from breaking. Fragile means ____.
items.explanationMd: 为了防止破碎而小心包装，fragile 意为易碎的。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: The children visited a pond after heavy rain. They looked into the water. The pond was murky; the children could not see the stones beneath its surface. Murky means ____.
items.explanationMd: 看不见水下石头说明池水浑浊、不清澈。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 作者态度：从明确评价和行动推断态度，避免将建议误当绝对保证。
items.stemMd: The writer attended a local event last weekend. Many neighbours gathered to listen. I enjoyed the community concert and hope it returns next year. The writer feels ____.
items.explanationMd: enjoyed 和 hope it returns 表明满意。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 作者态度：从明确评价和行动推断态度，避免将建议误当绝对保证。
items.stemMd: A reviewer recently visited the new library. The review discusses its services. The author praises the new library but notes that its hours are too short. The view is ____.
items.explanationMd: 赞扬图书馆但指出开放时间短，是肯定中有保留。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: A team plans to release a new app. The writer gives advice about the launch. The writer suggests testing the new app with a small group before wider use. This suggests a ____ approach.
items.explanationMd: 先小范围测试再推广体现谨慎，并不保证成功。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 推断与证据：优先选择能由原文支持的最小结论，避免绝对化。
items.stemMd: Maya arrived at a shop late in the evening. She wanted to buy bread. The lights are off and the door is locked. The shop is probably ____.
items.explanationMd: 关灯且锁门，最合理推测是关门。

items.subject: english
items.materialMd: 推断与证据：优先选择能由原文支持的最小结论，避免绝对化。
items.stemMd: Noah had an appointment in another town. He chose to travel by train. Noah left early to catch the first train. What can be inferred?

options.text: He wanted to take an early train.

items.explanationMd: 提前出发赶首班车，说明想乘早班车；不能推断是否误车。

items.subject: english
items.stemMd: A school wanted to improve its playground. Volunteers planted trees there in spring. After several trees were planted, the playground had more shade at noon. Which conclusion is supported?

options.text: The trees caused all clouds to vanish.
The playground is now cool in every season.
No other factor could affect shade.
The new trees may have increased shade.

items.explanationMd: 植树后阴影增多支持可能有关，但单凭描述不能排除其他因素。
